Spooky season already underway in Louisville; several haunted houses opening

Digital Media Manager

LOUISVILLE, Ky. —

Halloween really starts in (early) September in Louisville.

Several of the big haunted attractions in the region start this weekend.

In the video player above: Footage from last year's Waverly Hills haunted house

Malice Manor in Clarksville, IN and Haunted Hotel in south Louisville actually opened last week.

American Horrorplex, a big haunted house in the city's Portland neighborhood, is opening Friday.

Devil's Attic in south Louisville opens Saturday.

Field of Screams, a big, spooky corn maze in Brandenburg, KY kicks off Sept. 18, as does Grim Trails at Tom Sawyer Park.

Waverly Hills, Louisville's famous haunted hospital, will start its haunted house on Sept. 25. This is the first date for Baxter Avenue Morgue in Louisville and House of Anguish in New Albany, as well.

This year's Goatman Festival at Pope Lick Park is Oct. 15-18.
